extDescription.message: Hands your downloads over to the Colibri download manager.

popupCaptureHint.message: Eligible downloads follow Colibri’s Capture, Ask or Keep in browser policy. Safety restrictions and exclusions take precedence.

popupStatusNotRunning.message: Colibri is not running. It starts when a download is captured.

popupStatusHostMissing.message: Native host missing or access denied. Open Colibri → Settings → Browser integration → Install / repair.

popupSite.message: Do not capture on this site

captureAttention.message: Paused in browser: Colibri has not confirmed cleanup. Open Colibri and stop its transfer before manually resuming this file from your browser's Downloads page.

onboardingIntro.message: Install Colibri, then enable its native browser integration.

onboardingStepOne.message: Open Colibri and select Settings → Browser integration.

onboardingStepTwo.message: Choose Install / repair for this browser. Keep the browser extension enabled.

onboardingStepThree.message: Return here and check the connection. For private windows, allow this extension in the browser’s extension settings and enable private capture in Colibri.

popupUpdateError.message: Colibri could not save this change. Reconnect and try again.

popupNoSite.message: Open a website to change its capture setting.

popupProtocolError.message: Update Colibri and this extension to compatible versions.

pickerIntro.message: Review up to 500 discovered links. Nothing is fetched until you choose links and continue.

pickerDestination.message: Filename categories are hints. Colibri applies its destination and queue settings; this version cannot preview them.

pickerReady.message: Choose the links you want to send. This list expires after five minutes.

pickerPending.message: Waiting for Colibri confirmation. This list cannot be submitted again while the offer is pending.

pickerAccepted.message: Colibri accepted the confirmed selection. Review its download list for individual transfers.

pickerBrowser.message: Acceptance was not confirmed. Check Colibri before opening a new picker; a lost reply can leave an app transfer running. No browser downloads were canceled.

pickerAttention.message: Colibri has not confirmed cleanup. Open Colibri and review or stop its transfers before trying again.

pickerExpired.message: This list expired or its browser session ended. Use the page menu to collect links again.

pickerInvalid.message: Choose 1–100 valid links. If their request context is too large, collect a smaller selection.

pickerExcluded.message: A selected link or its source page is now excluded. Review your Colibri settings and collect links again.

pickerPrivate.message: Private capture is disabled in Colibri. This selection was not sent.

popupSiteScoped.message: This switch changes the exact-host exclusion. Additional app rules may still keep downloads in the browser.

popupOpenError.message: Colibri could not be opened. Check host registration and compatible versions, then try again.

policyReadOnly.message: Category defaults from Colibri. Change actions and scoped exclusions in the desktop settings.

policyLegacy.message: This app supplies a legacy file-type list. Eligible listed downloads ask for confirmation.

reasonPrivacy.message: Reason codes only, kept in memory for this background session. Private captures are omitted.

reasonNone.message: No decision recorded in this session.

reasonDisabled.message: Kept in browser: capture is disabled.

reasonPrivate.message: Kept in browser: private capture is restricted.

reasonExcluded.message: Kept in browser: an app exclusion matched.

reasonMethod.message: Kept in browser: only observed GET requests can be replayed.

reasonMinimum.message: Kept in browser: the known file size is below the configured minimum.

reasonPreference.message: Kept in browser: this file type is configured to stay in the browser.

reasonScheme.message: Kept in browser: this URL scheme is unsupported.

reasonRules.message: Kept in browser: the legacy file-type or minimum-size rule did not match.

reasonSafety.message: Kept in browser: the request context could not be safely handed off.

reasonBypass.message: Kept in browser: the configured bypass modifier applied.

reasonAssociation.message: Kept in browser: no unique eligible request could be associated.

reasonUnconfirmed.message: Acceptance was not confirmed. The browser copy is retained; review Colibri after an interrupted handoff.

policyOverrides.message: $COUNT$ extension overrides may change these defaults.

mediaHint.message: Direct filename audio/video hints only. Quality and size are unknown. Protected media and HLS/DASH are unsupported here. Choose one source for Colibri confirmation.

mediaEmpty.message: No eligible direct audio/video filename sources found in this frame.

mediaExpired.message: This selection expired. Open Choose page media again.

mediaFallback.message: No confirmed acceptance. Check Colibri before choosing again; page playback stays available.
